title: E/371/2011 — Shreenath Plastopack Pvt Ltd vs. Vadodara-ii
text:
In The Customs, Excise & Service Tax Appellate Tribunal
West Zonal Bench At Ahmedabad
E/ROM/10286/2018-SM
Appeal No.E/371/2011-SM
Shreenath Plastopack Pvt Ltd Appellant
Vs
C.C.E. & S.T.-Vadodara-II Respondent
Represented by:
For Appellant:None
For Respondent: Shri S.N. Gohil(AR)
CORAM:
HON’BLE DR. D.M. MISRA, MEMBER (JUDICIAL)
Date of Hearing/Decision: 24.04.2018
Misc. Order No. _M/__ 10332 __/2018
Per: D. M. Misra
Non present for the applicant. Through the letter dated
24/04/2018, the applicant requested for deciding the Miscellaneous
application for rectification on merit.
2. Ld. AR for the Revenue submits that there was a typographical
error in mentioning the amount in the order dated 13/02/2018. The
amount shown at para 2 and 8 as Rs. 12,26,279/- but the correct
amount is Rs. 22,26,279/-. Consequently the said mistake is allowed
to be corrected and it should be read as Rs. 22,26,279/- instead of Rs.
12,26,279/-. MA(ROM) is allowed.
(Dictated and pronounced in the open court)
(Dr. D.M. Misra)
Member (Judicial)
seema
